丹江口库区为什么强调"清水北送"？

Why does the Danjiangkou reservoir stress "sending clean water north"?

它供给中线调水，水质直接关系北方饮水安全；因此库区要严控污染、退养、造林，把"水干净"放在产量之前。
It feeds the middle route, so its quality directly affects northern drinking water; the area strictly controls pollution, removes fish pens and plants trees, putting clean water before yield.

南水北调为什么是"四横三纵"的格局？

Why is the South-North Water Transfer laid out as "four horizontals, three verticals"?

"四横"是长江、黄河、淮河、海河四大水系，"三纵"是东、中、西三条调水线；用南北通道把丰水的南方水引向缺水的北方，像给水系"织网"。
The "four horizontals" are the Yangtze, Yellow, Huai and Hai river systems; the "three verticals" are east, middle and west routes—north-south channels moving water from wet south to dry north, weaving the basins into a network.

跨流域调水，为什么可能改变"调出区"的生态？

Why can inter-basin water transfer change the ecology of the "donor" region?

丹江口等水源区水位、流速与湿地随之改变，岸线生态和下游用水节律都受影响；调水不是"免费的水"，需要把调出区的代价也算进账本。
Source areas like Danjiangkou see changed levels, flow and wetlands, affecting shoreline ecology and downstream use; transferred water isn't free—the donor's cost must be counted too.
